nested_oof_plugs.protocol: leave-one-depth/core-out, 8 groups; inner lambda up to 3 folds; grid [0.1,1,10,100]

interpretation: Nested: M3 does not beat M0 on joint OOF (-2%); criterion not met.
M3 improves Vp/Vs and parameter stability (less alpha at bounds).
Profile: M3 reduces MAPE/bias vs DSI but Pearson r stays ~-0.17.
High nested lambda pools HFUs nearly to a global (alpha,s).
Useful as modest profile bias fix; not as depth-tracking model.
